subject: SummitAI pilot commercial ask — discount & packaging
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Carla Mendes <carla@summitai.ai>
Date: 2026-11-10T09:12:00Z
Subject: SummitAI pilot proposal + packaging options

Hi Carla —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Attached is the pilot proposal we discussed (commercial-summary.pdf) and a simple pricing model so your procurement team can see the unit economics (pricing-model.xlsx). High level:

- 3-month pilot (non-production)
- 2 dedicated inference pools (NVIDIA A100 equivalent)
- Usage estimate: ~350M tokens / month
- Proposed list discount: 18% off published on-demand rates (volume-based tiering included)

We can provide the pilot under a fixed monthly commitment to keep the onboarding overhead low. If you'd like deeper discounts we can consider a short-term onboarding credit or a higher commit.

Next steps: if procurement is comfortable, send over your standard PO/term sheet and I’ll loop in legal for a short SOW. If you need me to present this to your CFO/procurement, happy to schedule a 30-min walkthrough this week.

Cheers,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

--
Attachment stubs:
- commercial-summary.pdf (1 page)
- pricing-model.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Carla Mendes <carla@summitai.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T14:03:00Z
Subject: Re: SummitAI pilot proposal + packaging options

Jonas —

Thanks for the proposal and the model, that helps. Quick feedback from Procurement/CFO: the pilot is compelling but the ask for 18% off doesn't get us to the internal threshold for moving faster. They'll need ~25% off list for a quick greenlight, and they prefer a short-term true-up if usage scales. We're happy to commit to the 3-month pilot and to provide usage telemetry if that helps.

Can you escalate an approval path for a one-off concession? We need to know if that 25% is doable (and if so any commercial conditions).

Best,
Carla Mendes
Head of Business Operations, SummitAI
carla@summitai.ai

On Tue, Nov 10, 2026 at 09:12 Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> [original proposal attached]
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T16:30:00Z
Subject: Fwd: SummitAI pilot — request for 25% discount (need approval)

Marissa / Markus —

SummitAI (prospect) is asking for a 25% one-off concession on the 3-month pilot to move ahead quickly. Quick context: strategic healthcare AI prospect, clear intent to pilot inference with private data connectors; expected to convert to paid within 3–6 months if pilot shows value. Forecasted year-1 spend (if converted) ~ $350k net.

My suggested path: approve up to 22% with the following guardrails:
- 90-day review clause with automatic reprice if usage/quality thresholds are hit
- Minimum spend guarantee for pilot (commitment: $40k for the 3 months)
- Limit the concession to the pilot period only; renewal at standard tiers thereafter
- Product to enable prefix caching and a burst quota cap to limit unit costs for us

Attachments: commercial-summary.pdf (one-pager), pricing-model.xlsx (detailed math). I'm asking for an executive signoff (Markus) for anything above 20%.

Please advise quickly — Carla indicated procurement wants a yes/no by EOW.

Thanks,
Jonas

--
Attachment stubs:
- commercial-summary.pdf
- pricing-model.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T18:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: SummitAI pilot — request for 25% discount (need approval)

Markus —

Jonas' note below is right. SummitAI is small but strategically valuable (healthcare partner, high expansion potential). Sales recommends 22% as a middle ground; I agree with the guardrails Jonas proposed.

If you can approve 22% for the pilot with the 90-day review and the $40k commitment, we should be able to close this by Friday. If you prefer we can require a parent-level purchase order and a short SLA addendum (cost allocation, burst caps) before finalizing.

Happy to jump on a quick call if you'd like more color.

-M

Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-13T09:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: SummitAI pilot — request for 25% discount (need approval)

Jonas / Marissa —

Thanks for the concise memo. I approve a one-off 22% discount for the 3-month pilot under the following conditions (please capture in the SOW):

1) Pilot commitment: $40,000 total over 3 months (non-refundable credit against usage).
2) 90-day commercial/usage review — if SummitAI's monthly token consumption exceeds 500M in any month or we see repeated bursts causing >15% higher unit cost, price reversion to published tiers is triggered.
3) Renewal/expansion pricing will default to standard committed tiers; any further concessions require VP-level signoff.
4) Procurement must sign our standard MSA amendment and confirm data handling controls (SOC2 attestation will be provided).

Jonas — send the revised one-pager and a short executive approval note to Carla; CC me on the DocuSign. I want the SOW to include the review clause verbatim.

-Markus

Markus Klein
Chief Financial Officer, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
